# Sherpa-ONNX Rust bindings

Source: https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx
Revision: `8e7ca3cdfae616420b951ce063dc53dbcf2cc572`
Version: 1.13.4
License: Apache-2.0 (included in both crates).

Only the two Rust crates are vendored. Native libraries are acquired separately by a pinned version and verified checksum. Ayla modifications to the sys build script require explicit bootstrap and prevent hidden native downloads.
